title: What they said at the time

clips.q: …and they got their heads handed to them.
clips.who: **Larry Carlat**, editor of Toy & Hobby World, on Child World’s failure to set itself apart from Toys “R” Us, Los Angeles Times, Oct 25, 1990[^2]

clips.q: We make investments in things people don’t like.
clips.who: **Stanley P. Gold**, Shamrock Holdings, a month before Trefoil walked away, Oct 1990[^2]

clips.q: The toy market may be what dreams are made of, but it is one tough industry.
clips.who: **Sally Schaadt**, toy analyst, Fourteen Research, May 1992[^1]
